text:
Priya: Quick heads-up from the sample-app audit: we found a class of issues where client prefetch + retry-on-auth create backpressure and duplicate page hits. Repro attached.
Theo: Can you summarize the failure mode?
Priya: TL;DR: prefetch kicks off page=N concurrently with user fetch; if auth refresh happens mid-flight the retry flow replays the original request, resulting in 2x identical GETs and occasional 429s. Happens more under bursty scroll.
Nia: Which SDK? Is this JS-specific?
Priya: Mostly JS (web + electron sample apps) because we default prefetch=true there. Python/Go don't prefetch by default, so less exposure.
Carlos: Any quick mitigations?
Priya: For sample apps we patched prefetch to: 1) dedupe in-flight identical queries via a singleflight map, 2) add a tiny random jitter before prefetch retry after auth refresh, and 3) optional prefetch=false toggle for flaky auth environments.
Theo: Example dedupe helper: `const inflight = new Map(); function fetchDedupe(key, fn){ if(inflight.has(key)) return inflight.get(key); const p = fn().finally(()=>inflight.delete(key)); inflight.set(key,p); return p; }`
Nia: Nice. Do we want that in SDK or only in sample apps? SDK parity concern: adding behavior in JS only might surprise users.
Carlos: Proposal: add opt-in SDK flag `clientOptions.dedupeInFlight: boolean` default false, document tradeoffs. Sample apps enable it. Also doc the auth-retry interaction in onboarding.
Theo: Tests needed: concurrency, token refresh slow path, memory leak when many unique cursors. Also ensure cancellation still works (if user navigates away).
Priya: I ran a stress run: 150 concurrent scroll events with token refresh latency 900ms -> baseline w/o dedupe: ~22% 429s; with dedupe + jitter: 0.8% 429s.
Nia: Server-side fallback: can infra add a cheap LRU dedupe for GETs within 50ms? That would be helpful but might not be appropriate for all endpoints.
Carlos: Infra thoughts?
infra-bot: Noted. We can prototype conservative dedupe on read endpoints behind a feature flag, but it requires careful validation to avoid masking real duplicate intents. Filing infra-2491.
Theo: Action items: 1) Sam to draft SDK opt-in PR with tests, 2) Priya to update sample apps and onboarding docs, 3) Audit other sample apps (mobile/desktop) for same pattern.
devex-bot: Created DEVEX-7007 "js-sdk: opt-in inflight dedupe + prefetch auth docs" and assigned @Sam.
Priya: I'll link the repro and the sample-app PR in DEVEX-7007. Thanks team.
Nia: One more: add small note in rate-limits guide about client-side dedupe vs server idempotency for paginated reads.
Carlos: Agreed. Closing the loop after PR lands and we run the staging stress job.
